places.name: Hat Creek outfit's cow camp
places.note: Po Campo wins the crew with plover-egg omelet and fried grasshoppers; Jake arrives saying Lorena is gone, and Augustus rides off alone after Blue Duck.
places.location_hint: on the trail north through Texas, a day's move beyond the stampede site; Austin is within reach to buy a horse; the plains still lie ahead

places.name: Lorena's camp
places.note: Jake returns to find the camp gear left but Lorena and both animals gone; Augustus concludes Blue Duck took her.
places.location_hint: a couple of miles east of the herd's previous night's bed-ground

places.name: Austin
places.note: Jake stayed there gambling two nights instead of one; Call tells him he can buy a horse there.

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Augustus repeats Blue Duck's threat about coming north of it.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Jake heard talk there of Blue Duck's gang murdering travelers along the trails.

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Since the snake incident there, Lippy is terrified of snakes and keeps to the wagon.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Augustus guesses Po Campo's wife lives there; the cook says she is in hell instead.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call reminds the crew they are not there yet and should start the cattle.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: Call expects water to grow scarcer once the drive reaches the plains, so keeps Deets as scout.
places.location_hint: plains country north of central Texas, ahead of the drive

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: herd moving north; a day passes with no sign of Augustus or Jake

groups.label: Augustus
groups.hint: rode off alone at night to track Blue Duck and recover Lorena

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: rode out angrily on a worn-out horse, perhaps toward Austin
